name: Create and debug spreadsheet formulas
description: Users asked for assistance in writing, debugging, or explaining spreadsheet formulas to perform data lookups, conditional logic, text manipulation, and calculations. Some requests extended to using specific applications like Google Sheets or included VBA scripts for minor automation tasks, but the primary focus remained on cell-level formula construction and troubleshooting.
